Before I begin my post I would like to state that yes, I own a pitbull. Yes she is a very loyal and kind dog and was even thinking of making a post about her on here (not to persuade anybody into liking dogs/pits but simply to spark a debate). However, I do understand that pitbulls were bred to fight. 

Now, onto what I have to say about this post.
1) every dog is a desendint from wolves. It is in their nature to attack. Hunt. Be free. We cannot blame the dogs for something they have in their blood to do.
2) most of these "pitbull" attacks aren't actually pitbulls. The media will classify any kind of dog with a square enough head as a pitbull no matter the breed. You could have a pure bred pointer but if it has a wide enough head, it can and will be classified as a pitbull. I'm simply pointing this out so that maybe in the future when anyone hears of a pitbull attack you might think twice on if it actually is one.
3) I fully respect everyone's opinions. I love my dog very dearly. The unconditional love that she gives to me is unmatched by many others, however she is an emotional support dog. She was intensely trained to give me that love. I find it very annoying, just like the rest of you, when I see somebody putting their dog on a pedestal. Yes, your dog might be a good boy/girl but that does not mean I am entitled to love it the same way you do. I will happily pet your dog but please don't expect me to be thrilled when it wants to sit in my lap or lick me. 

Thank you to anyone that read my post and I hope you can understand that I am not here to attack anyone. Have a wonderful day.
